settings.title: 01. Dispatch & Carrier Selection
settings.body: Orders are prepared in climate-controlled fulfilment and dispatched subject to formulation availability and payment confirmation. Exact shipping methods, transit windows, and charges are calculated and displayed at Shopify Checkout.

settings.title: 02. Temperature-Conscious Transit
settings.body: Because botanical lipids and lamellar emulsions are sensitive to extreme heat or freezing temperatures, we recommend express tracked delivery during peak summer or winter weather.

settings.title: 03. International Cosmetic Customs
settings.body: International orders outside the primary domestic market may incur destination VAT, GST, or import duties assessed by local customs authorities.

settings.title: 04. Damaged-in-Transit Replacement
settings.body: Should any glass vessel arrive cracked or leaking, contact Client Care with photographs and your order reference within 7 days of delivery for prompt replacement.

settings.heading: SHIPPING & DELIVERY
settings.intro: Every VESLORIA order is packed inside custom moulded-pulp protective cradles engineered specifically for heavyweight frosted flint and smoked glass vessels.
